guidance.summary: Camera module capacity to expand to 180-190 million units annually
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We will be expanding the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech, which is an ECMS beneficiary for smartphones from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months, largely catering to our captive smartphone volumes in addition to deepening the level of manufacturing, capturing more value add in India.

guidance.summary: Telecom and Networking vertical revenue high double-digit growth in current fiscal
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We expect this vertical to deliver high double -digit revenue growth in the current fiscal.

guidance.summary: IT hardware revenue 3x growth in current fiscal
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: The segment delivered a healthy performance for the quarter under review, and we expect 3x growth in the revenues in the current fiscal against last year with a huge uptake in order books from all customers.

guidance.summary: Lighting segment revenue to grow almost 2x in current fiscal
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: The JV with Signify continues to deliver strong revenue growth, and we expect the revenues to grow almost to 2x in the current fiscal.

guidance.summary: Camera module revenue target of INR2,500 crores
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: Last year, on an annualized basis, we did a revenue of INR1,700 crores. We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.

guidance.summary: Telecom network business revenue target of INR7,500-8,000 crores
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27. That's another major trigger of growth.

guidance.summary: Lighting target revenue of almost INR1,700 crores
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: In lighting, which was a laggard for us, we did almost INR800 crores, INR850 crores. The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores.

guidance.summary: High-margin specialty EMS business opportunities scalable to INR3,000-4,000 crores
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: So these are going to be higher -margin businesses. We feel that each would be -- I mean, the combined opportunities which come in are going to be at least scalable to the size of INR3,000 crores to INR4,000 crores with a significantly higher operating margins, significantly higher operating margins.

guidance.qualifier: without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat
guidance.summary: Targeting INR56,000 crores revenue in FY27 without Vivo
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat.

guidance.summary: Company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17% without Vivo
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We fe el that without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%.

guidance.qualifier: when component play is completely deployed
guidance.summary: Margin expansion from last year by almost 40 bps, 50 bps
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: Finally, when the component play is completely deployed, t here will be a margin expansion from last year's number by almost 40 bps, 50 bps.

guidance.qualifier: at 80% to 90% capacity utilization for display business
guidance.summary: Display business revenue target of INR5,500-6,000 crores
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: In the final picture of this business, the revenue target, once we start achieving 80% to 90% of the capacity utilization, the revenue generation is going to be almost INR5,500 crores to INR6,000 crores with a double -digit margin.
